Known quality caveat from the theme screen stands: ~92% of the recent revenue surge is acquisition-driven rather than organic, so this is sized conservatively (opportunity-tier, market cap ~$4.3B) to the remaining Technology sector-cap room (~$31.65, sector already ~29.2% of portfolio) rather than a full position, funded by available cash above the 2% buffer floor.
